Hi Hanna — thanks for sending.

Quick update from our side: Finance has flagged a mismatch when validating the VAT ID provided on the invoice against VIES. Until we confirm the VAT ID and that the reverse-charge applies, the accounts payable team has placed the payment on hold as a precaution.

Naomi, Neha — looping you in to confirm whether the VIES screenshot attached is sufficient or if we need the official SE VAT registration extract.

Hanna — could you also confirm the VAT number exactly as it appears on your government VAT certificate and resend the certificate if possible (mobile photos are fine). That will help speed up validation.

Apologies for the delay — we'll prioritize this once finance confirms.

Best,
Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Hanna Berg <hanna.berg@scandesign.se>
Date: 2026-05-15T10:42:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Invoice SD-4567 and payment status

Hi all,

I checked the VAT number on the invoice (SE556677889901) in the VIES portal and received a negative match. I've attached a screenshot of the VIES response for the record.

For outbound payment to proceed under reverse-charge, we require evidence that the supplier VAT number is active and the customer is registered for VAT in the supplier country (or a valid EU VAT registration for B2B reverse-charge to apply). If the VIES result remains negative we need one of the following: a local tax authority confirmation, a VAT registration extract, or a government-issued VAT certificate that clearly shows the VAT number and company name.

If none of those are available, we must treat the invoice as subject to standard VAT and process tax withholdings accordingly — which could require a corrected invoice.

Naomi
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: VIES_screenshot-20260515.png
From: Hanna Berg <hanna.berg@scandesign.se>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-17T08:21:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Invoice SD-4567 and payment status

Thanks for the quick look, Naomi.

Apologies — the VAT number on our invoice had a transcription error. The correct VAT ID is SE55667788990 (one fewer digit). I'm attaching an official VAT registration extract from the Swedish Tax Agency as proof. Please confirm once you've validated the corrected number and if you need a revised invoice with an explicit reverse-charge note.

I'll also upload the certificate to the customer portal and share a DocuSign link if you prefer an e-signed corrected invoice.

Best,
Hanna
attachments: VAT_certificate_ScandiDesign.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Invoice SD-4567 and payment status

Hi Hanna — thanks for the swift follow-up and for sending the registration extract. Naomi and I validated the corrected VAT ID (SE55667788990) against VIES and received a positive match. We've requested a corrected invoice that references the EU reverse-charge article and includes your correct VAT ID; I see Soojin indicated you'd share a DocuSign link if you prefer.

Next steps on our side:
- Once corrected invoice (or credit + replacement) is uploaded, finance will release the payment — ETA 5 business days from receipt.
- We'll add a note to the HubSpot deal and attach the VIES confirmation and your certificate.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765 (Deal DEAL-8391)

If you prefer, send the corrected PDF to billing@redwood.com and CC Naomi.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
